To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the BIS banking and financial statistics are an invaluable resource for monitoring the financial sector and that they are particularly useful in the context of procyclicality.

(i) the BIS banking and financial statistics are useful for gauging procyclicality in Asia; (ii) the BIS financial statistics are useful in identifying the build up of systemic vulnerabilities; and (iii) current vulnerabilities are low, but not absent.
The BIS banking and financial statistics are an excellent source of information on the build up of financial system procyclicality.
